name: react-router
title_zh: 路由配置从声明到数据流，一份技能全接管
tagline_zh: 在 Framework、Data、Declarative 模式间切换不迷路，loader、action。
tagline_en: Switch between Framework, Data, and Declarative modes without getting lost—loaders, actions, pending UI, even RSC.
desc_en: Build applications with React Router in Framework, Data, Declarative, and unstable RSC modes. Use when configuring routes, route modules, loaders, actions, forms, fetchers, navigation, pending UI, SSR/SPA/pre-rendering, middleware, URL params/search params, or React Router upgrades.
why_zh: 不是零散 API 问答，而是按模式组织路由心智模型，从配置到数据流串成一条线。
why_en: Not scattered API Q&A—organizes routing mental models by mode, connecting config to data flow, mapping old syntax to new during.
limit_zh: 只认 remix-run/react-router 的 v6/v7 写法，不覆盖 Next.js。
limit_en: Only for remix-run/react-router v6/v7 patterns; not for Next.js or TanStack Router. Outputs code examples and explanations, doesn't edit your.
title_en: Route config to data flow, one skill for React Router
